The log ends mid-incident — still failing at `03:59:27.974Z`, the last line in the file, `waiting` climbing past 74. So the impact window is `02:14:18Z` onward, unresolved as of end of log.

**On-call handoff**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, `a.novak`, applied `02:12–02:14Z`) shipped config generation 119, flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. That change makes every request grab its own DB connection instead of sharing the pool, exhausting the fixed pool of 20 connections.

**Impact window:** started `2026-03-14 02:14:18.972Z` (first `503` + `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, `req-07401 /v1/cart`). Still ongoing at `03:59:27.974Z`, the last line in `gateway.log` — `waiting` count still climbing (74+). Not self-resolved.

**Scope:** gateway only. Cross-checked `worker.log` for the same window — all jobs completed normally, no pool errors, no 503s. One unrelated `WARN` slow-query at `02:36` is pre-existing (`OPS-2210`), not tied to this incident.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471` — revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false` (config gen 119 → prior).
